note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000; these are gameplay classifications, not legal citations. Economy: post-Soviet transition economy with partial privatisation and a large state sector. Press: major broadcasters state-owned or owned by business groups close to the authorities, alongside an independent print press. Elections: competitive multi-party elections in which administrative resources favoured incumbents. Conscription: universal male service. Religion: secular constitution with no state church. Energy: a mix of nuclear power, coal and imported gas. Healthcare: tax-funded state system inherited from the USSR.
